description: This file defines a Flutter widget `DailyReportsScreen` that displays daily attendance records, summaries, and allows date navigation and data refresh. It interfaces with an `AttendanceProvider` for data loading and manages UI states like loading, error, empty, and data presentation.

classes.name: DailyReportsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays daily attendance data with navigation controls, summaries, and detailed records.

classes.name: _SummaryPill
classes.description: A widget to display summarized attendance metrics with color-coded labels.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state, sets the current date to today in UTC, and triggers initial data load via the provider.

methods.name: _formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into 'yyyy-MM-dd' string in UTC timezone.

methods.name: _formatHumanDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a human-readable string in local timezone.

methods.name: _pickDate
methods.description: Displays a date picker dialog for user to select date, updates state, and triggers data reload.

methods.name: _changeDay
methods.description: Adjusts the selected date by a delta (±1 day) and triggers data reload.

methods.name: _refresh
methods.description: Reloads the data for the current selected date.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including date navigation, refresh logic, loading/error/empty states, summaries, and records list.
